# The Vivid Alchemist

> Vivid color & hair studio based in Bloomington, Indiana. Jennifer mixes every shade by hand, from full vivid transformations and prism pops to moonlit blondes and herbal scalp rituals, in a one-chair studio just off the Bloomington square.

- Phone: (812) 518-5003

## Services
- Vivid transformations: Full or partial bleach-out and custom vivid color, mixed for you and finished with a restorative treatment.
- Vivid refresh & prism pop: Keep the magic glowing between transformations, or try vivid on just your bangs or money piece.
- Moonlight & soft glow blondes: Full blonding or a soft balayage refresh, with bond strengthening and a custom toner.
- Natural color & color correction: Rich natural tones, glossing and root retouches, and a Reset Ritual for color that went wrong elsewhere.
- Shaping ritual (haircuts): Precise cuts and soft layers shaped to your hair, plus a treatment and product advice.
- Herbal & purifying rituals: Plant-based scalp and hair care: herbal oil infusions, scalp massage and a hard-water detox.

## About
The Vivid Alchemist is Jennifer Simonelic's single-chair studio, tucked inside Lunar Hare salon at 236 N Morton St, a short walk from the Bloomington square. She calls it a single-chair sanctuary where the art of hair meets the magic of transformation. One chair means one client at a time: your appointment is yours, start to finish. Jennifer is a vivid colorist first. Rainbows hidden under brown hair, emerald panels, crimson waves, pastel lilac, moonlit blondes: every shade is mixed by hand at an apothecary counter of bottles, bowls and herbs. Clients say she listens, makes a plan, and teaches them how to care for their color at home, so it stays bright and the hair stays healthy. Everyone is welcome here, every style and texture. Book a bold transformation, a precise cut, or an herbal scalp ritual, and expect a fun, friendly visit with transparent pricing.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book with The Vivid Alchemist?
  A: Book online through Jennifer's booking page, or call (812) 518-5003. A card is needed to hold your appointment, and longer color sessions take a deposit. Appointments run Monday to Friday.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: 236 N Morton St in downtown Bloomington, inside Lunar Hare salon, near the square. There is garage and street parking nearby, and the studio is wheelchair accessible.
- Q: How long does vivid color take?
  A: Plan on about 6 hours for a Full Vivid Transformation, 5 for a partial and around 4 for a Vivid Refresh. Most vivid clients refresh every 6 to 12 weeks.
- Q: Can you fix color that went wrong?
  A: Yes. The Reset Ritual is a dedicated color correction session with bond-building, glossing and a recovery haircut. Pricing depends on your color history.
- Q: How do I keep my vivid color bright?
  A: Every color service includes aftercare education and product recommendations for your hair. Reviewers mention their hair has never looked healthier.
- Q: Do you do regular haircuts too?
  A: Yes. The Shaping Ritual is a precise cut with styling and a restorative treatment: $35 short, $45 medium, $55 long.
